scripts.deps: pnpm --dir deps/celler install --frozen-lockfile --pm-on-fail=ignore && pnpm --dir deps/celler run --pm-on-fail=ignore build && pnpm --dir deps/vindu install --frozen-lockfile --pm-on-fail=ignore && pnpm --dir deps/vindu run --pm-on-fail=ignore build && node deps/skalet/scripts/build-binaries.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives packages scripts test pi && knip
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:host && node --test --test-randomize --import ./test/setup.ts test/*.test.ts && go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./... && pnpm run test:pi
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:host && node --test --test-randomize --import ./test/setup.ts --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='packages/**' --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=70 --test-coverage-functions=75 test/*.test.ts && node scripts/coverage-go.mjs && pnpm run test:pi
scripts.test:pi: python3 -I -B -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s pi/setup -t pi/setup && python3 -I -B -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s pi/tv -t pi/tv && python3 -I -B -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s pi/controllers -t pi/controllers
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build && node --test test/browser.mjs test/browser-workspace.mjs test/browser-turns.mjs test/browser-folder.mjs test/browser-box.mjs test/browser-git.mjs test/browser-tv.mjs && node --test --import ./test/setup.ts test/host-browser.ts test/pads-browser.ts
